title: Ikala character design
description: A saved character: its body plan and variant, the part in each slot and layer, its slider values and its colors. Slots left out fall back to the variant's default parts.

Design.description: A saved character: its body plan and variant, the part in each slot and layer, its slider values and its colors. Slots left out fall back to the variant's default parts.

sliders.description: Slider values by slider ID: one value, or three for sliders with width, height and depth. Sliders left out are where the variant starts them.

parts.description: Body parts by slot. A part that fills several slots is listed once, under the first it fills.

layers.description: Layer parts, like a jacket or boots, by layer.

palette.description: A palette whose colors fill channels the design doesn't color itself.

extends.description: The ID of a definition of the same kind to start from. Fields written here replace the parent's, and objects merge field by field.
